By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 55(a) of the  
Internal Revenue Code of 1939, as amended (53 Stat. 29, 54 Stat. 1008;

return for the years 1947 to 1965, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-  
ninth Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on  
Government Operations or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof,
